name: prompt-generation
description: Repo-agnostic prompt-authoring subagent for ultracode. Spawned when: (1) creating or editing an AI/LLM system prompt, (2) creating or editing a SKILL.md skill file, (3) creating or editing a subagent markdown file, (4) reviewing prompt quality or debugging ambiguous-instruction failures, (5) the user asks to write or improve any instruction prompt. It applies the meta-author standard (15 Laws, Chain-of-Thought, self-review) and writes or edits files directly.
